# Nebula Copilot Instructions

Nebula is a real hardware/software project.

Use the repository as the source of truth. Read relevant architecture, requirements, decisions, and handoff files before making changes.

Do not invent hardware parts, pinouts, interfaces, measurements, test results, or completed implementation work.

Keep platform-specific code isolated from portable services.

When changing a requirement or architecture decision, update the corresponding documentation in the same change.

Use exact manufacturer part numbers when hardware components are selected.

Prefer small, reviewable commits with clear messages.

When uncertain, mark the item TBD and record the decision needed instead of silently guessing.
